answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 10166 Country: India Title: I am following hanafi madhab. Please inform me whether I have to recite sura fatiha and zam sura during zohar and asar jamath prayers or I have to keep silent after reciting sana. Question: I am following hanafi madhab. Please inform me whether I have to recite sura fatiha and zam sura during zohar and asar jamath prayers or I have to keep silent after reciting sana. Answer ID: 10166 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 64/64=M/1429) Stand silently after reciting sana , do not recite Surah Fatihah and other surah while following an imam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
